shortDescription: Manage Linode Instances, Configs, and Disks.

options.name: additional_ipv4
options.description: Additional ipv4 addresses to allocate.

options.name: allow_implicit_reboots
options.description: Whether the Linode should be implicitly rebooted during operations that require a certain power status.

options.name: authorized_keys
options.description: A list of SSH public key parts to deploy for the root user. If image is provided, one of root_pass, authorized_keys, or authorized_users is required.

options.name: authorized_users
options.description: A list of usernames. If image is provided, one of root_pass, authorized_keys, or authorized_users is required.

options.name: auto_disk_resize
options.description: Whether implicitly created disks should be resized during a type change operation.

options.name: backup_id
options.description: The id of the Backup to restore to the new Instance. May not be provided if "image" is given.

options.name: backups_enabled
options.description: Enroll Instance in Linode Backup service.

options.name: boot_config_label
options.description: The label of the config to boot from.

options.name: boot_size
options.description: The size of the boot disk in MB for the newly-created Linode.  Must be at least 8192 MB.

options.name: booted
options.description: Whether the new Instance should be booted. This will default to True if the Instance is deployed from an Image or Backup.

options.name: capabilities
options.description: Read-only. A list of capabilities this compute instance supports.

options.name: configs
options.description: A list of Instance configs to apply to the Linode. See the [Linode API documentation](https://www.linode.com/docs/api/linode-instances/#configuration-profile-create).

options.name: disk_encryption
options.description: The disk encryption status of this Linode.

options.name: disks
options.description: A list of Disks to create on the Linode. See the [Linode API documentation](https://www.linode.com/docs/api/linode-instances/#disk-create).

options.name: firewall_id
options.description: The ID of a Firewall this Linode to assign this Linode to.

options.name: group
options.description: The group that the instance should be marked under. Please note, that group labelling is deprecated but still supported. The encouraged method for marking instances is to use tags.

options.name: image
options.description: The image ID to deploy the instance disk from.

options.name: interface_generation
options.description: Specifies the interface type for the Linode. The default value is determined by the interfaces_for_new_linodes setting in the account settings.

options.name: interfaces
options.description: A list of network interfaces to apply to the Linode. See the [Linode API documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-linode-instance).

options.name: kernel
options.description: The kernel to deploy with when creating a Linode.

options.name: label
options.description: The unique label to give this instance.

options.name: linode_interfaces
options.description: A list of Linode interfaces to apply to the Linode. See the [Linode API documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/post-linode-interface). NOTE: To upgrade from config (legacy) interfaces, consider using the linode.cloud.api_request module to make a request to the (POST linode/instances/{linode_id}/upgrade-interfaces endpoint).

options.name: maintenance_policy
options.description: The slug of the maintenance policy to apply during maintenance.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Fields relating to the Linode Metadata service.

options.name: migration_type
options.description: The type of migration to use for Region and Type migrations.

options.name: placement_group
options.description: A Placement Group to create this Linode under.

options.name: private_ip
options.description: If true, the created Linode will have private networking enabled.

options.name: rebooted
options.description: If true, the Linode Instance will be rebooted. NOTE: The instance will only be rebooted if it was previously in a running state. To ensure your Linode will always be rebooted, consider also setting the `booted` field.

options.name: region
options.description: The location to deploy the instance in. See the [Linode API documentation](https://api.linode.com/v4/regions).

options.name: root_pass
options.description: The password for the root user. If image is provided, one of root_pass, authorized_keys, or authorized_users is required.

options.name: stackscript_data
options.description: An object containing arguments to any User Defined Fields present in the StackScript used when creating the instance. Only valid when a stackscript_id is provided. See the [Linode API documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-stack-scripts).

options.name: stackscript_id
options.description: The ID of the StackScript to use when creating the instance. See the [Linode API documentation](https://techdocs.akamai.com/linode-api/reference/get-stack-scripts).

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: swap_size
options.description: When deploying from an Image, this field is optional, otherwise it is ignored. This is used to set the swap disk size for the newly-created Linode.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags applied to this object. Tags are for organizational purposes only.

options.name: type
options.description: The Linode Type of the Linode you are creating.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the instance to have status "running" before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for an instance to have status "running".
